pages.title: Gravitational
pages.text: Drags everything within reach toward its core, flings the unlucky skyward, and swallows loose blocks and dropped items. The more it eats, the larger and hungrier it grows. $(br)$(o)Counterplay:$() feed it until it collapses in an explosion - or simply walk out of its pull.

pages.title: Electrical
pages.text: Lashes nearby creatures with arc lightning on a cycle. The bolts are showy; the damage is real. $(br)$(o)Counterplay:$() set a battery with a large empty energy buffer beside it. The anomaly dumps its charge into the buffer and dissipates.

pages.title: Radioactive
pages.text: Bathes the area in a heavy dose. Players accumulate radiation; other creatures simply cook. $(br)$(o)Counterplay:$() none. This one is permanent. Shield up and keep your distance.

pages.title: Thermal
pages.text: Sets everything in range alight and periodically throws off a small explosion. May ignite the landscape if your server allows it. $(br)$(o)Counterplay:$() drown it - enough water source blocks against the core put it out for good.

pages.title: Psi
pages.text: Floods the minds of nearby $(o)players$() with blindness, nausea, weakness, and slowness, and conjures vexes for company. Other creatures are unaffected. $(br)$(o)Counterplay:$() a direct hit from the $(item)Q36 Quantite Disruptor$(). The splash does not count.

pages.title: Spatial
pages.text: Hovers above the surface, blinking from spot to spot, and hurls anything that strays too close up to a hundred blocks away. Do not approach. (Per Directive 12-B, which exists because someone did.) $(br)$(o)Counterplay:$() a direct hit from the $(item)Q36 Quantite Disruptor$().
